p: two tribes and an half tribe: As Reuben and Gad and half the tribe of Manasseh, Nu 32:33.
two tribes: So though Levi lacked, yet were there still twelve tribes by this means.
thee in Kadeshbarnea: Which was that only those two should enter into the land, Nu 14:24.
brethren that went up with me: Which were the ten other spies.
if so be the LORD will: This he spoke out of modesty, and not from doubting.
great man among the Anakims: Either for his power or person.
